title: Show wire parameters from a panel on every view update
summary: Unhides every wire parameter on a schematic sheet through nested iterators, from a command, a dockable panel, or automatically after each edit via a registered notification handler and a per-document view added with AddView; documents the view codes AD actually sends.
phrasings: run code after every schematic edit
attach a view to a schematic document
receive document activated notifications in C#
iterate the parameters of each wire

commands.name: ShowPanel
commands.description: Open the wire parameter panel (lists the current sheet's wire parameters and the AutoShow state)

commands.name: ListWireParameters
commands.description: List the wire parameters of the current sheet with their hidden / draw / selected state (read-back helper)

commands.name: ShowWireParameters
commands.description: Unhide and select every wire parameter of the current sheet; returns how many were changed

commands.name: AutoShow
commands.description: Switch the automatic mode (notification handler, per-document view, ShowWireParameters on view code 6) on or off, or report it with the notifications received
